item.title: [−1] Sensex falls 319 points to 81,592.45 and Nifty 0.61% to 25,144.30 on inflation and oil worries
item.description:
Autos, metals, realty and financials led Friday's selling after October inflation of 6.09% and a rebound in crude. Both indices still posted a third straight weekly gain. Rally pausing after Thursday's flat close.

Metals, cement & chemicals: mild headwind (−1) — Metals sold

Why it matters: Inflation above the RBI's ceiling raises rate-hike odds and hits rate-sensitive sectors first; costlier oil and higher US yields add pressure after a steep November rally.

Market gauges: Equities (Nifty & Sensex) −1, Inflation outlook −1

Confidence: high · horizon: days

item.title: [−1] Brent holds near $96 but heads for a second weekly fall of about 2% as the US keeps its Iran blockade
item.description:
Brent traded around $95.5–96.5 on Friday with WTI near $88, after Thursday's 3.3% jump. Iran denied talks with Washington. Rebound from Tuesday's dip below $90 is holding.

Metals, cement & chemicals: mild headwind (−1) — Feedstock costs

Why it matters: Crude back in the mid-$90s keeps India's import bill, fuel under-recoveries and inflation risk high just as CPI has breached 6%.

Market gauges: Inflation outlook −1, Fiscal & trade balance −1, Rupee −1

Confidence: medium · horizon: weeks
